title: Refund
description: A refund of an order, paid back to a card or a bank account. Every type here has a provider-ready schema, so the LLM decoders read all of it.

amounts.description: The amount refunded in each currency, in cents, at least one currency.

issuedAt.description: When the refund was issued, an RFC 3339 date-time.

codes.description: Up to three different codes of three upper case letters.

memo.description: A memo for the customer, 1 to 40 characters.

version.description: The version of the refund format, always 1.

final.description: Always true: a refund can't be undone.

destination.description: Where the money goes: back to a card or to a bank account. Both may carry a note.

cardRefund.description: Back to the card that paid.

last4.description: The last four digits of the card number.

note.description: A note for the card holder, at most 20 characters.

iban.description: The account's IBAN, at least 15 characters.

note.description: A note for the account holder, at most 20 characters.
